name: VRM_LINE_GROUPS
description: New entity for storing of line groups along with aggregate columns.

columns.name: GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a line group.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Document type of the source document.

columns.name: TOTAL_QUANTITY
columns.description: Total quantity within a VSOE price basis data set.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of a line group.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the pricing dimension combination.

columns.name: DIMENSION_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates whether pricing combination is successfully derived for the given document line.

columns.name: MAX_USP_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Maximum unit selling price of a line group.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: The code name of the unit of measure.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the line group.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: The source document or MEA number.

columns.name: MEA_FLAG
columns.description: Information about the line group and whether it is for a MEA or standalone.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: The source document items type. The valid values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The revenue recognition item type unique identifier.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: The unit selling price of the source document line.

columns.name: EXTRACTION_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of an extraction period.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Source document unique identifier.
